nodes.label: FR-059: Validate And Normalize Event Response Names
Event Response Name Normalization
nodes.rationale: Before creating or updating an Event Response the system removes control and Unicode-format characters, trims whitespace, and normalizes to Unicode NFC, because normalized names must be comparable and display-safe; the normalized name must be non-empty, no more than 100 code points, and reject values that look like the account identifier in its lowercase hyphenated UUID form.

nodes.label: Event Response Display-Name Uniqueness
nodes.rationale: Display names are unique within an event across all guests after normalization; a signed-in guest whose profile-derived default name is taken must be rejected until they choose a distinct display name, while a guest may own multiple responses for the same event.
